subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session scheduling, validation plan, and actions
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@brightbridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sally Harris <sally.harris@brightbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on working session availability

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightBridge is excited to get the hands-on POC going. We're aiming for a working session focused on: prompt review (customer prompts), routing rules for multi-tier models, and a short load validation run to confirm latency at 100 QPS.

Can we book a 90-minute slot next week? Preferential windows for our engineers are Tue/Wed mornings (PDT). Also would appreciate a quick pre-read if you have a recommended agenda or a runbook.

Attendees on our side: Alex (eng), Sally (PM), and 2 backend engineers (TBD).

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Gomez
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightBridge
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on working session availability

Alex — thanks, excited to get this moving.

Proposed 90-minute agenda (can tighten):
- 00:00–00:10: quick intros & success criteria (business + technical)
- 00:10–00:35: prompt walkthrough + prompt set mapping (we'll load your sample prompts)
- 00:35–01:05: routing config & model variants (live config demo)
- 01:05–01:25: 15–20 minute load validation (baseline 100 QPS, two model variants)
- 01:25–01:30: actions & next steps

Availability I can offer: Tue 2027-04-20 09:00–10:30 PDT or Wed 2027-04-21 09:30–11:00 PDT. Karthik and Ben will cover the load run; Laura will take notes and own the action log.

Pre-reads: I'll attach a short runbook and sample prompt CSV. If you can drop 6–8 representative prompts (and the expected quality baseline), that will help keep the session focused.

If those windows work I can send a calendar invite and a short Slack channel for live troubleshooting.

Cheers,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@brightbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on working session availability

Looping in a quick operational note — Ben and I will need the BrightBridge network IP range to temporarily whitelist for the load validation ramps, and we should cap the first run to 50 QPS for the initial smoke before going to 100 QPS. Two concrete asks from infra side: 

1) Please provide the IP range or confirm you'll use our test client behind NAT (either works).
2) If you want 100 QPS sustained, send the expected request/response size (average token length) so we can estimate concurrency and batch sizing.

I also recommend splitting into two back-to-back sessions if you prefer less risk: 45–60 mins for prompt + routing, then a separate 30–45 mins for load validation with infra on-call. That keeps the main stakeholders engaged for the detailed prompt work.

Attaching a lightweight runbook draft (POC_Runbook_v1.pdf) and a proposed load-plan template (load-plan.xlsx).

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf), load-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@brightbridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on working session availability

Grace/Karthik — thanks for the details. Wed 2027-04-21 09:30–11:00 PDT works for us if that slot is still open. We can start at lower QPS and ramp to your 100 QPS target — I expect average responses of ~120 tokens. I'll send the IP range in a separate note (security team wants to approve first).

We prefer to keep it as a single 90-minute session if possible since our engineers' calendars are tight; but if you prefer the split, we can accommodate. Also attaching our sample prompts file (sample-prompts.csv).

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightbridge-poc-20270421 (invited)

Alex

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-session recap and actions — BrightBridge POC (Apr 21)

Alex/Sally — thanks again for yesterday; great session. Below is a short recap and owners for the agreed actions. I've also attached the final POC runbook and the combined prompt file we used.

Recap (what we covered):
- Prompt review: loaded your sample-prompts.csv; highlighted 3 prompts with expected baseline issues (Prompt IDs 3, 7, 14) that need small prompt clarifications.
- Routing: configured a two-tier routing rule (fast small-response model vs high-quality model) and demonstrated canary routing for 10% traffic.
- Load validation: performed a staged ramp to 100 QPS; observed median latency 220ms for small model, 480ms for high-quality model at 100 QPS. No infra failures; a single transient 503 at the 60s mark during the high-variant ramp (Ben captured traces).

Action items and owners:
1) Alex (BrightBridge) — provide final list of 6 priority prompts and the approved IP range for whitelisting. Due: 2027-04-25.
2) Karthik (Redwood) — update load-plan.xlsx with the observed latencies and recommended batch sizing; add automated retry policy example. Due: 2027-04-26.
3) Ben (Redwood) — attach traces for the 503 and initial hypothesis (network spike); share in Slack channel. Due: 2027-04-23.
4) Laura (Redwood) — formalize action log and share a short recording snippet + meeting notes. Due: 2027-04-22 EOD.
5) Grace (Redwood) — prepare a concise follow-up runbook (POC_Runbook_v1 -> POC_Runbook_v1.1) including the canary config and routing snippet. Due: 2027-04-27.

Attachments: POC_Runbook_v1.1.pdf, combined-prompts.csv, load-plan.xlsx (updated).

Next meeting: recommended 30-minute sync week of 2027-04-26 to review Ben's traces and Karthik's load updates. Proposed: Tue 2027-04-27 10:00–10:30 PDT. Please confirm availability.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
